title: Account access
text: Use the approved account recovery page to request a reset link. Never share a password or one-time code with support staff.

title: VPN connection
text: Check the VPN status page and confirm that the client is up to date. If the connection still fails, record the error code for the support team.

title: Software update
text: Check the approved software catalogue for the latest version. Save work before installing an update and contact support if installation fails.
